You're hired as a new postal worker in Whistvale and immediately provided with housing right on the job. Management assures you there's no need to leave the building, and the locals seem quite content. However, the longer the work goes on, the more questions the surrounding environment begins to raise.

Mail with too many secrets

The workday begins quite normally. Letters need to be sorted, packages weighed, stamped, and mailed to the appropriate addresses. The life of the entire island passes through your hands: requests, news, bills, confessions, and strange messages whose meaning isn't always clear at first glance. Sometimes, it's the content of the letters that helps you understand what's going on better than any conversation.

Residents eagerly visit the post office, share stories, and make all sorts of requests. It gradually becomes apparent that the island lives by its own rules. Some topics are off-limits, and questions about the outside world create a noticeable tension. The more closely you examine your surroundings, the stronger the feeling that the postman's work is just one part of a much stranger story.

Features of the game

Work in a post office sorting letters and parcels. Communication with the inhabitants of the mysterious island. Exploring mysteries through letters and everyday events. An atmosphere of psychological mystery and hidden tension.

24382.description:
D.O.T. Defence — is a real-time strategy game that combines base defense, fortification construction, and large-scale automated battles. Controls remain simple and straightforward, but behind the surface lies a wealth of tactical decisions. The primary objective remains the same: hold your own headquarters and destroy the enemy's command center, wisely managing your army's resources and capabilities.

You have to constantly change tactics

The campaign offers dozens of missions, with familiar rules regularly changing. Some missions emphasize classic clashes of armies, while others require stealth, rapid completion of objectives, or an unconventional approach to troop deployment. Sometimes you have to repel endless waves of enemies, while other times you become a virtually unstoppable force capable of turning the tide of an entire operation.

The economy is closely tied to territorial control, so it's important not only to build turrets but also to hold key areas of the map. Defenses can be adjusted during battle to adapt to new threats, and base development opens up additional defensive options. Thanks to short matches and a variety of modes, the game constantly offers new tactical challenges without feeling repetitive.

Features of the game

Real-time strategy with dynamic matches. A campaign with multiple storylines and varied missions. Defend your base with turrets and develop your economy. Several modes, including wave defense and classic battles.

Your task is to forge weapons, sturdy armor, and reliable shields with your own paws, fulfill unusual orders from adventurers, and gradually expand your production. Although you can't fight with a sword yourself, you can help the heroes prepare for dangerous expeditions and craft equipment capable of leading them to victory over the demonic dragon. Download MeowCraft You can use the torrent on your PC to develop your own forge, trade, and craft legendary equipment.

Cat Master's Forge

The work begins with the processing of common metal, which must be manually transformed into useful equipment. Every hammer strike affects the result, and the finished products must be meticulously polished before being displayed. As the workshop's reputation grows, customers increase, and the simple shop gradually transforms into a prominent trading post in the capital of Meow. In addition to standard orders, you can study complex blueprints and fulfill custom requests from particularly demanding adventurers.

Regular equipment is sometimes insufficient, so you can use magical gems found in dungeons in the forge. Each assistant has their own skills and can perform forging, research blueprints, or other production tasks, including mysterious feline technologies.
